runs.text: Israel fits in Antarctica six hundred and forty three times. Here's Israel at true size: twenty two thousand and seventy two square kilometres. West Bank and Gaza shaded, not counted. Now, let's go far. Greenland: ninety eight. Almost the same as Saudi Arabia. Australia: three hundred and forty eight. Brazil: three hundred and eighty six. The Sahara: about three hundred and ninety. Its edges are fuzzy, so call it an estimate. And Antarctica: six hundred and forty three Israels of ice. The biggest drop of all. Every copy is true size, even at the South Pole. Size isn't everything. Plenty of this is ice and sand. Where on Earth should I drop Israel next? Count it again.
